_note: New actor, first pricing entry. PAY_PER_EVENT, tiered from day one: a bet from a wallet ranked in the profit leaderboard's top N is the row alert buyers act on, so it carries the premium. No per-run free allowance (a poller). Runs with no new bets return nothing and cost nothing. Compute is a few JSON requests, no proxy.

whale_bet.eventDescription: One Polymarket bet at or above your minimum size, with market, outcome, side, size, average price, payout if right, and the bettor's wallet, all-time and 30-day profit rank and PnL. A run with no new bets is free.

smart_money_bet.eventDescription: One large bet from a wallet ranked within your cut-off on Polymarket's profit leaderboard (all time or last 30 days) with positive profit, with the same fields and the ranks that qualified it. A bet is charged once, under one event only.
